description: For somebody leaving a shift and somebody arriving: a front desk, a kitchen, a ward, a shop. Needs nothing but this phone, and the other person in front of you.
name: Handing the shift over

steps.description: Each thing, with where you got to, not only that it is open.
steps.title: Say what is still open

steps.description: Anything that is not the way it was at the start: a person, a machine, an order, a rule.
steps.title: Say what changed this shift

steps.description: What you chose not to do or not to say yet. If you do not say why, they cannot tell whether to carry on.
steps.title: Say what you held back, and why

steps.description: The one thing you tripped on, or nearly did.
steps.title: Say what will surprise them

steps.description: Ask them to say it back in their own words. Confirm only once they have.
steps.title: Read it back

steps.description: One, written down in a line. If it keeps coming back, it is the next thing to fix.
steps.title: Note one snag from this shift
